title: 사과 편지를 받는 인형, 로버트
disclaimer: 실제 장소·기록 기반 | 초자연 현상은 전해지는 이야기입니다

lines.text: 이 인형은 지금도, 매년 사과 편지를 받습니다.
lines.img: a pile of old handwritten letter envelopes addressed to Robert on a dark wooden table, wax seals, a single candle, dust
an old white Victorian wooden mansion in Key West Florida at night, palm trees, fog, pale moonlight, one lit upstairs window

lines.text: 1900년대 초, 한 소년이 선물받은 인형. 이름은 로버트.
lines.img: a faded 1900s sepia antique photograph of an old creepy handmade rag doll, not a human, not a child, not porcelain, made of yellowed stained burlap cloth with visible stitched seams and straw poking out, crude embroidered face with tiny black shoe-button eyes and a stitched mouth, wearing a faded dirty white sailor suit and sailor hat, holding a small worn stuffed toy lion, sitting on the porch steps of a Victorian house, scratched old photo

lines.text: 가족들은 빈 방에서, 둘이 대화하는 소리를 들었다고 합니다.
lines.img: an old creepy handmade rag doll, not a human, not a child, not porcelain, made of yellowed stained burlap cloth with visible stitched seams and straw poking out, crude embroidered face with tiny black shoe-button eyes and a stitched mouth, wearing a faded dirty white sailor suit and sailor hat, holding a small worn stuffed toy lion, sitting alone on a small wooden chair in a dim Victorian child's bedroom, staring forward

lines.text: 물건이 깨지면 소년은 늘 말했죠. 로버트가 그랬어.
lines.img: an old creepy handmade rag doll, not a human, not a child, not porcelain, made of yellowed stained burlap cloth with visible stitched seams and straw poking out, crude embroidered face with tiny black shoe-button eyes and a stitched mouth, wearing a faded dirty white sailor suit and sailor hat, holding a small worn stuffed toy lion, sitting on the floor of a pitch dark bedroom at night, long shadow on the wall, a broken porcelain vase on the floor, moonlight from a window

lines.text: 1974년 주인이 죽은 뒤, 새 집주인은 인형이 자신을 방에 가뒀다고 주장했습니다.
lines.img: a closed wooden attic door in an old Victorian house at night, faint warm light leaking under the door, dust, ominous, small doll silhouette sitting in front of it

lines.text: 1994년부터 로버트는, 박물관 유리관 안에 앉아 있습니다.

lines.text: 규칙은 하나. 사진을 찍기 전에, 허락을 구할 것.

lines.text: 무시한 사람들은, 불운이 따랐다며 사과 편지를 보냅니다.
